'''Estijan''', or the '''Federal Estijan''' '''Republic,''' is a country spanning across northern [[Ayuma]]. It is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|largest country in the world]] and spans three time zones, sharing land borders with nine other countries. With over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|260 million people]], Estijan is the most populous country in [[Ayuma]] and the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|sixth-most populous in the world]]. It is a highly urbanized country, with thirty-five of its urban areas having more than 1 million inhabitants. [[Shabiran]] is the capital and largest city of Estijan and part of the [[Pariaga megacluster]], one of the largest in the world.

[[wikipedia:Human_settlement|Human settlement]] on the territory of modern Estijan dates back to the Lower ____. The [[Yvian culture]] emerged as a recognized group in [[Ayuma]] between the 4th and 8th centuries AFA. The [[Yvian culture|first Yviran state]], the [[Uvei Kingdom|Uvei]], arose in the 9th century, and in 842 it adopted ____ from the [[Yethran Empire]], who originated from [[Alzuria (region)]]. The [[Uvei Kingdom|Uvei]] ultimately disintegrated; the [[Uillam Kingdom]] led the unification of Estijan lands, leading to the proclamation of the Estijan Huan in 1430. By the late 16th century, Estijan had vastly expanded through [[wikipedia:Conquest|conquest]], annexation, and the efforts of Estijan [[wikipedia:/Exploration|explorers]], developing into the Huan, which remains the [[wikipedia:List_of_largest_empires|Second-largest empire in history]]. However, with the [[Grain riots]] and [[Nationalist coup]] in 1678, Estijan's [[wikipedia:Monarchy|monarchic]] rule was abolished and eventually replaced by the new government, the world's first [[wikipedia:Nationalism|nationalistic government]]. Following the [[wikipedia:%27%C3%A9tat|coup]], the Nationalists established the newly reorganized [[Estijan Huan State]]. The new nationalist [[Estijan Huan State|Estijan Huan]] underwent rapid [[wikipedia:Industrialisation|industrialisation]] in the 1680s, amidst the [[Estijan 1682 Famine|deaths of millions]] under nationalistic rule, and later played a decisive role for the Accord in the [[Red War|Red war]] by leading large-scale efforts on the [[northern front]]. With the onset of the [[Cold War]], it competed with [[Raledria]] and later on [[Dahe]] for economic dominance and [[wikipedia:Sphere_of_influence|international influence]]. The nationalist era of the 16th and 17th centuries saw some of the most significant Estijan [[wikipedia:Technology| technological achievements]], including the first [[wikipedia:Nuclear_power_plant|nuclear power plant]] and one of the most important inventions in history, the [[wikipedia:Transistor|transistor]]. In 1740, Estijan emerged from the [[Collapse of the Huan|dissolution of the Huan]] as the Federal Estijan Republic. A new [[constitution]] was adopted, which established a [[wikipedia:Federal_republic|Federal semi-presidential republic]]. Since the 50s, Estijan's political system has been dominated by [[wikipedia:Economic_stagnation|economic stagnation]], under which the country has experienced growing [[wikipedia:Democratic_backsliding|democratic backsliding]] and has become a [[wikipedia:Defective_democracy|flawed democracy]]. Estijan has been militarily involved in several conflicts in the former [[Estijan Huan|Huan states]] and with other countries, including its 1747 war with [[Danocia]] and several standoffs with [[Fermori]].

Estijan is generally a [[wikipedia:Great_power|great power]], possessing the [[List of states with nuclear weapons|third-largest stockpile of nuclear weapons]] and having the [[List of countries with highest military expenditures|sixth-highest military expenditure]] in the world. It has a [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|high-income economy]], which is the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|fifth-largest in the world by nominal GDP]], relying on its vast mineral and [[wikipedia:Rare-earth_element|rare earth resources]]. However, Estijan ranks middling in international measurements of [[wikipedia:Democracy|democracy]], with better human rights and [[wikipedia:Freedom_of_the_press|freedom of the press]] than some of its neighbours and also has high levels of [[Corruption Perceptions Index|perceived corruption]]. It is a member state of the [[Global Trade Union]], [[Main 16]], [[EISA]], [[LLO]] and many others. Estijan is home to 25 [[Global Heritage Sites]].
